displayName: Sweet Corn + White Clover Undersown (living mulch)
benefit: Dutch white clover undersown into corn at V4 to V6 establishes after canopy closure, suppresses weeds, fixes 40 to 60 lb N per acre, and provides erosion protection after harvest. Strong fit in sweet corn rotation.

members.title: Frost-seed white clover at corn V4 to V6
members.body: Broadcast Dutch white clover at 6 to 8 lb per acre when corn is 12 to 18 inches tall. Light cultivation to set seed. Clover establishes under canopy.
